methods.name: shellWeightCalc(calibre, calLength, dateFactor)
methods.formula: weight = calibre^3 / 1.9830943211886; if calLength < 45 multiply by (45 - sqrt(45 - calLength)) / 45, else if calLength > 45 multiply by (45 + sqrt(calLength - 45)) / 45; finally multiply by dateFactor (= sqrt(dateAdjCalc(year))).
methods.plimsoll_equivalent: $.systems.weapons.<battery_id>.facts.projectile_mass_kg is a declared fact, not this estimate.
methods.note: No Plimsoll estimating chain: Plimsoll has no shell-mass estimate; projectile mass must be declared with a source.

methods.name: gunWeightCalc(calibre, calLength, barrels, dateAdj, gunType, mountType, mountAdj, weightAdj)
methods.formula: gunWeight = shellWeightCalc(calibre, calLength, dateAdj) * (calLength / 812.389434917877 * (1 + (1/calibre)^2.3297949327695)) * barrels, and zero when calibre <= 0 or barrels <= 0.
methods.units: pounds for the whole battery of barrels
methods.note: Plimsoll multiplies a declared unit mass by a declared installed count; it never regenerates the mass from calibre.

methods.name: gunWeightCalc mount branch
methods.formula: base mountWeight by mountType (0:0.83, 2:3.33, 4:3.15, 5 and 6:1.08, default 3.5); multiplied by a gunType factor that depends on whether mountAdj < 0.6; then += 1 / calibre^0.313068808543972; then *= gunWeight; if calibre > 10 multiply by (1 - 2.1623769 * calibre / 100); finally *= weightAdj (the mount-count-weighted group adjustment).
methods.units: pounds for the whole battery of mounts
methods.note: No Plimsoll estimating chain: The mount estimate is entirely index-driven and calibre-driven.

methods.name: weightAdjCalc(mountNo) and perMountCalc(mountNoIndex)
methods.formula: weightAdj = 0.75 when the guns-per-mount index is 3, 6, 9 or 12, else 1. perMount maps the 15-index combo to barrels per mount (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10 by index).
methods.note: No Plimsoll estimating chain: Plimsoll has no barrel-per-mount class.

methods.name: mountsCalc()
methods.formula: Derives per-group barrel counts (raised, on deck, below deck) from the mount counts and per-mount barrels; the group 1 deck remainder is mounts minus all other group counts, and the group 1 barrel remainder is barrels minus all other group barrels; then weights the group adjustments and free-gun ratings by group mount counts.
methods.note: The two-group arrangement model (which mounts are raised, on deck or in casemates) has no counterpart in the declared Plimsoll weapons contract.

methods.name: super ratio in mountsCalc
methods.formula: super = (gunSuperG1 + gunSuperG2 * gunSuperG2Adj - gunSubG1 - gunSubG2 * gunSubG2Adj) / barrels, then super = (super * max(7.5, calibre * 0.6) + freeGun) / freeGun. gunSuperG2Adj and gunSubG2Adj are 2 when the corresponding checkbox is set, else 1.
methods.note: No Plimsoll estimating chain: The superfiring-height effect enters only through these two checkboxes and the barbette estimate.

methods.name: freeGunCalc(layout, mounts)
methods.formula: Maps the 18 layout indices to a fore/aft split of the mount count and returns a weighted free-gun rating built from the Freeboard page free-gun values.
methods.units: a free-gun rating in feet as carried by the Freeboard page
methods.note: No Plimsoll estimating chain: Plimsoll has no free-gun (weather-deck exposure) rating.

methods.name: layoutCalc(gunLayout, gunMounts, group)
methods.formula: Sets layoutText, superAft and gunPosition (fractions of the fore or aft freeboard deck length) for each of the 18 layout indices; indices 0-2, 9-11 force gunPosition to 1 for group 1 and 0 for group 2.
methods.note: No Plimsoll estimating chain: Mount longitudinal placement is an SPS arrangement model; facts.placement is free text and drives nothing.

methods.name: armWeightCalc() and diameterCalc(mountWidth, calibre, weightAdj)
methods.formula: diameter = num * calibre * (1 + (1/calibre)^num2) from the mount-width class (num/num2 pairs 1.44/0.609725, 1.52/0.4205, 1.64/0.29, 1.8/0.2, 2.0/0.14), plus 12/calibre when calibre < 12, times 0.9 when weightAdj < 1. gunHouseHeight = max(7.5, 0.625 * calibre) (twice the calibre for a Coles/Ericsson turret). Face, back and bottom armour masses are assembled from these diameters, the mount counts, the free-gun rating, super, dateGunAdj and the three armour-thickness inputs; the code multiplies by main.INCH = 0.0185, an empirical constant whose unit basis is not asserted here.
methods.units: reported as long tons in armWeightBox
methods.note: No Plimsoll estimating chain: Plimsoll treats mount armour only as a declared, non-additive split of a sourced mount mass.

methods.name: magazineCalc()
methods.formula: magazineWeight = magazine * barrels * shellWeight / 2240 * 1.2444444 (equivalently /1800); broadsideWeight = barrels * shellWeight.
methods.units: magazineWeight uses the as-written 1.2444444/2240 factor; broadsideWeight in pounds
methods.note: Plimsoll computes ammunition mass from declared rounds and a declared projectile (and charge) mass, not from a shell estimate; its broadside mass excludes charge and outfit by design and uses the declared broadside count.

methods.name: gunString()
methods.formula: Formats barrels, calibre (inches and mm), calibre length, shell weight (lb and kg), rounds, gun type, mount type, design year, both group layouts, raised and below-deck counts, the superfiring label and the free-gun sea-state wording into the description box.
methods.note: Only the ledger rows behind the text have Plimsoll equivalents.

methods.name: gunWarningsAll()
methods.formula: Cross-checks gun type against mount type and design year (for example no muzzle-loading gun in a modern turret before 1880, no anti-air gun before 1910) and calibre against gun type, raising status-bar warnings.
methods.note: No Plimsoll estimating chain: Plimsoll has no historical gun/mount/date consistency checking.

coverage_note: Every estimating control in the recovered gun editor has no Plimsoll estimating chain. What Plimsoll does have is declared, sourced inputs: the installed count, rounds per gun, the broadside count, projectile and charge mass, calibre and the rotating-armour component. None of them is ever regenerated from calibre, barrel length, design year or mount type.
